subject: May invoice: unexpected duplicated token charges — request for investigation
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@sprucetech.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: SpruceTech Accounting <accounting@sprucetech.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: May invoice discrepancy: duplicated token charges?

Hi Dylan,

Our finance team received the May invoice (attached) and we're seeing a cluster of duplicated token charges across two days (May 12–13). The attached redwood_usage_export_may26.csv shows identical session IDs and token counts for repeated POSTs from our ingestion pipeline — looks like a retry/dedup issue on our side, but we want to confirm whether Redwood billed both requests or deduplicated server-side.

Specifically:
- Two session IDs (sess_9c1f and sess_9c1f-dup) show identical token counts (43,210 tokens) and both appear on the invoice.
- Invoice INV-2026-05-789 line 34 and 35 show the duplicate line items.

I've attached the invoice and a short CSV extract. Can your team confirm whether these were billed twice on Redwood's end, and if so, how to proceed with a correction/credit? Our quarter-end VAT reporting is coming up so we need an amended invoice if a credit is issued.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call. I'm available Thu morning.

Best,
Lina Park
Head of Cloud Operations, SpruceTech
Lina.Park@sprucetech.com
Attachments: sprucetech_invoices_May2026.pdf (pdf), redwood_usage_export_may26.csv (csv)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@sprucetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: May invoice discrepancy: duplicated token charges?

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear notes and the attachments. I've looped in Marissa (billing) and Rishi (finance) to triage. Quick plan:
1) Marissa will pull the raw request logs and our billing reconciliation for May 12–13.
2) If we find double billing due to a platform-side duplication, we'll propose a provisional credit and issue an amended invoice for VAT purposes.
3) If the duplication originated entirely from SpruceTech retries, we'll still help with the investigation and provide the evidence you need for your downstream reconciliation.

Can you confirm the session IDs you mentioned match the identifiers in the CSV (sess_9c1f and sess_9c1f-dup)? Also, if you can send any internal retry logs or the ingestion request IDs that would speed this up. I'm available Thu 9:00–11:30 PT for a call.

I'll treat this as high priority.

—Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: none
From: Lina Park <lina.park@sprucetech.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: SpruceTech Accounting <accounting@sprucetech.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: May invoice discrepancy: duplicated token charges?

Thanks, Dylan.

Confirming the IDs: sess_9c1f and sess_9c1f-dup. I've attached an internal audit snippet (audit_token_log_snippet.txt) showing our retry attempts from May 12 14:02–14:07 UTC. We also included the request UUIDs. There were two identical POSTs at 14:03:21 and 14:03:22; our system didn't de-dup because the upstream load balancer reissued the request.

We would appreciate Redwood's confirmation that both attempts were billed — if so, please advise on proposed credit mechanics and whether Redwood can issue an amended invoice with the VAT line adjusted.

Availability for a quick sync: Thu 10:00–10:30 PT.

Best,
Lina
Attachments: audit_token_log_snippet.txt (txt)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@sprucetech.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: May invoice discrepancy: duplicated token charges? — initial findings

Hi Lina / Dylan,

I've pulled the billing reconciliation for the window you flagged (May 12 14:00–14:10 UTC). We see two adjacent request records for the same conversation hash and identical token counts — both were matched to charge events in our metering pipeline. At first glance it looks like the requests were not collapsed server-side because the request IDs differed; our de-duplication logic uses a request UUID plus a short time window and, in this case, the upstream retry changed the UUID.

What we can offer immediately: a provisional credit covering the duplicated token volume (43,210 tokens x 2 = 86,420 tokens duplicated) translated to the billed amount on INV-2026-05-789 line items. Pending a full audit, we propose applying the provisional credit to your July invoice and then issuing an amended May invoice showing the VAT correction.

Action items I need from SpruceTech to finalize:
- Confirm whether you want a provisional credit (applied to next invoice) or an immediate refund.
- Confirm the billing contact for the amended invoice (should be accounting@sprucetech.com).

I'll start a deeper audit of the token ingestion logs and share a reconciliation CSV when available.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_usage_export_may26.csv (csv) — reconciliation in progress
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Lina Park <lina.park@sprucetech.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: May invoice discrepancy: duplicated token charges? — provisional credit approved

Hi all,

Thanks Marissa for the triage. Finance has approved issuing a provisional credit equal to the duplicated line items on INV-2026-05-789. Proposed handling:
- Provisional credit applied to SpruceTech July invoice (net amount).
- Redwood will produce an amended May invoice (INV-2026-05-789-A) showing the adjustment and updated VAT lines so SpruceTech can use it for VAT reporting.
- We will confirm the final credit amount after Marissa's full reconciliation (expected by EOD Tue 6/8).

Please confirm whether application to July is acceptable to SpruceTech accounting or if you require an immediate refund. Also confirm the billing contact for the amended invoice.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Lina Park <lina.park@sprucetech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: SpruceTech Accounting <accounting@sprucetech.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: May invoice discrepancy: duplicated token charges? — acceptance and VAT request

Thanks, Rishi / Marissa.

Application of the provisional credit to July's invoice is acceptable. Please issue the amended May invoice (INV-2026-05-789-A) with corrected VAT lines and send it to accounting@sprucetech.com. For our records we also need a brief write-up describing the cause (retry/dedup behavior) and the reconciliation CSV so our auditors can match items.

One question for Redwood finance: will the amended invoice replace the original for VAT reporting (i.e., show a negative adjustment line), or will it be an additional credit note? Our tax team prefers an amended invoice where possible — please confirm the format.

We appreciate the quick response and look forward to Marissa's final reconciliation.

Best,
Lina Park
Head of Cloud Operations, SpruceTech
CC: accounting@sprucetech.com
Attachments requested: reconciliation CSV, brief root-cause note
